title: Karma Chhina Cornered; Sukha Singh Accepts the Duel

blocks.text: The next episode opens after the Singhs have ravaged the village and pressed hard upon Karma Chhina's fort. Karma Chhina proposes single combat when the fort can no longer save him, realizing that the besieging Singhs will not simply withdraw and forget his crimes.
His offer is also an admission of weakness. Trapped and frightened, he tries to turn the crisis into an honorable duel before the siege strips him even of that last dignity.

Sukha Singh answers the challenge at once and offers a direct encounter without confusion from missiles or supporting fire. The page therefore shifts from collective siege warfare into a concentrated test of individual bravery and justice.
